notes: Exalted: The Lunars supplied and intake in progress. 122 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/lunar/inventory/: the core innate powers, the full Shapechanging I/II/III Charm trees, the full Body Enhancement I/II Charm trees, the full Unarmed Combat I through V Charm trees (completing the entire Unarmed Combat Charm category), and the full Melee Combat I/II and Ranged Combat I/II Charm trees (completing the entire Melee and Ranged Combat Charm categories). Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet, and Chapter Five has more Charm trees left uninventoried (Defensive, Survival and Healing, Perception, Stealth, Presence/social, Spirit, and Sorcery-access Charms), plus Backgrounds, Merits/Flaws, and caste/tribe creation options. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
